instructions.question: Is this Facebook comment on a Kosovo public-health COVID-19 post mainly positive, mainly negative (an attack, accusation, mockery or alarm), or neutral?
instructions.rule: Negative only when the comment's main point is hostile or distressed: it claims the numbers are faked or copy-pasted or that the institute lies, mocks the institute ('you've become like bettors'), insults or swears, or voices alarm or despair that things are out of control. Questions, pointing out mismatched numbers, demands or suggestions for measures (even shouted), opinions about causes, short political remarks, town-ranking or betting banter, and jokes with tagged friends are neutral. Praise, thanks, prayers, warm wishes to tagged people and relief at good numbers are positive.

neutral.what: Questions, number guesses, pointing out mismatched figures, demands or suggestions for measures, opinions, brief political remarks, banter, jokes, tags, anecdotes.
examples: Mbyllni kufijte sot! (Close the borders today!)
Prap Prishtina spe lshon kreun e tabeles (Again Prishtina won't give up the top of the table)
Albin Kurti i ka fajet.. (Albin Kurti is to blame..)
neutral.cues: pse/qysh/sa ? (why/how/how many ?); mbyllni/hapni (close/open); duhet (should); lige/tabele/bast (league/table/bet); tagged names; haha
neutral.not_for: Claims of deliberate faking or copy-paste, direct mockery of the institute, insults, and 'lost control' alarm are negative.

positive.what: Approval, thanks, blessings, prayers, warm wishes, and relief or cheering about recoveries and falling numbers.
examples: Ju lumte per punen suksese! (Well done for the work, success!)
Dati Begu perhajr perhajr (Dati Begu, for good, for good)
So keq sa per fillim (Not bad for a start)
Kur don zoti per bajram dalum 0-0 (God willing, by Bayram we come out 0-0)
positive.cues: bravo; ju lumte (well done); faleminderit (thank you); perhajr (for good); me shnet (in health); amin (amen); zoti na ruajt (God protect us); inshallah (God willing); urime (congratulations); sosht keq (it's not bad); lutem (I pray)
positive.not_for: Sarcastic blessings ('Kerrrk Na kofshi per hajr') are negative; ironic 'Hajde ma gjall' (come on, more) cheering for more cases is neutral.

negative.what: Accusations of faked or copy-pasted numbers or lying, sarcastic mockery of the institute, insults and swearing, alarm or despair about the situation.
examples: Dje 226 sod 224 mos jeni tja bo copy paste. (Yesterday 226, today 224, aren't you copy-pasting?)
Bajat jenii boo mooo pffff (You've become stale, pfff)
E hupi kontrollen e hupi Ferizaji (Ferizaj lost control)
Turp të kini (Shame on you)
negative.cues: copy paste; rren/rrena (lies); sa ju vyn (as many as you need); bajat (stale); si bastore/loto/KEK (like bettors/lottery/the power company); turp të kini (shame on you); budall (fool); nanen, mut (swearing); hupi kontrollen (lost control); kah po shkojmë (where are we heading)
negative.not_for: Plain questions about numbers, shouted demands for measures and banter about towns are neutral.
